excerpt.zh: [Leader.GetName]返回报告说，没有来自[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的人接见[Leader.GetHimHer]。
excerpt.en: [Leader.GetName] returned to report that no one from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] met [Leader.GetHimHer].

texts.zh: [Leader.GetName]返回报告说，没有来自[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的人接见[Leader.GetHimHer]。
texts.en: [Leader.GetName] returned to report that no one from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] met [Leader.GetHimHer].

texts.zh: 无人驾驶的太空梭内设有一个中央会议室。地面和墙壁覆盖着柔软的材料，而来自外星世界的平静自然声响则从隐藏的扬声器中播放出来。
texts.en: The pilotless shuttle contained a central meeting room. The floor and walls were covered in a soft material, while calming natural sounds from an alien world played from hidden speakers.

texts.zh: 无人驾驶的太空梭内设有一个中央会议室，其中一端有一个水池。外星符号环绕着水池周围的地板。
texts.en: The pilotless shuttle contained a central meeting room with a pool of water in one end. Alien symbols surrounded the floor around the pool.

texts.zh: 无人驾驶的太空梭内设有一个中央会议室，其装修风格既低调又奇异地给人一种庄严的感觉。墙壁的角度和装饰设计旨在将观者的注意力引向一个高高的讲台。
texts.en: The pilotless shuttle contained a central meeting room with an architectural style that was at the same time understated and oddly imposing. The angles of the walls and their ornamentation were designed to draw the viewer's attention towards a raised dais.

texts.zh: 无人驾驶的太空梭内设有一个中央会议室，令人惊讶的是，它非常朴素，缺乏任何装饰或装饰品。
texts.en: The pilotless shuttle contained a central meeting room that was surprisingly nondescript and lacking in decoration or adornment of any kind.

texts.zh: 有一面墙上装满了记录设备和传感器。站在冷漠的机器前，[Leader.GetName]概述了我们物种的历史和文化。演示没有得到任何回应。[Leader.GetName]感到十分沮丧，只能留下一个视频平板离开，平板中包含了大量历史记录和我们语言使用的入门指南。
texts.en: One wall was covered in recording equipment and sensors. Standing before the impassive machines, [Leader.GetName] outlined our species' history and culture. The presentation was met with silence. Frustrated, [Leader.GetName] left behind a video tablet with a vast collection of historical records and primers in our language.
